title: Skip Past Midnight
description: A bright square arpeggio skips and re-voices itself over a syncopated 2-step shuffle, all bouncy 808 sub and bittersweet minor-dorian chords. It peaks early into a vocal-stabbed garage rush, then deconstructs into delay-soaked echoes before a stripped outro.

setcpm(132/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.05),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.16, 8).hpf(7000),
    n("<0 2 4 7>/2").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.42).lpf(1600).delay(".4:.1875:.5").room(0.12)
